Why this role, and why now Our Chief People Officer is moving on after three and a half years. They leave behind a People Experience function that works well: predictable delivery, a capable team, a high bar on senior hiring, and a seat at the table that has been earned and respected. If you want a CPO role where the function is broken and the mandate is to fix it, this isn t it. If you want one where the function is strong and the question is what a leader can do with that platform, keep reading. The uncomfortable and energising fact about working here: our customers are HR leaders. What we do internally isn’t separate from what we sell. Our own practices are watched, asked about, and sometimes bought. It’s an incredible opportunity to innovate and create the future of work. We anticipate there may be interest from current and former customers, and we welcome it! Two things worth being upfront about; applications are visible only to our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams, never to our customer-facing teams. And, being a customer earns you no advantage and no disadvantage. We ll run the same process, set the same bar, and have the same people assessing you. What you ll own The role has several dimensions. They are listed in order of weight, and we mean the order. Run People Experience (PX) well This is a critical part of the job and the thing that has to be true before anything else matters. You ll own a strong and coherent function that delivers its cycles well and on time: performance, engagement, compensation, talent acquisition, capability, compliance across four countries. No surprises to the Exec. No escalations arriving at the CEO s desk that should have been resolved two levels down. The bar we re setting: your deputies own outcomes, not tasks. Executives go to them directly and get good answers. You design the org ahead of the strategy rather than in response to it, so that when the business changes direction the structure is already close to right. Your team respects you, and your senior hires raise the average. You ll be a trusted sounding board to Caroline and the Exec on structure, senior hires, compensation and the calls that don t have clean answers. Be credible in the market and with customers Our customers are your peers. That is a commercial asset, and we want you to use it. You ll speak at our global events and in the market, join customer conversations, and support Sales and Customer Experience in rooms where a practitioner s view might land differently to a vendor s. Over time we d like Sales to be asking for you by name and customers backchannelling you for advice on their own problems. To be clear about the bar: we are not hiring a keynote speaker. You don’t need to be a world-class presenter, and polish is not what we re screening for. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Working collaboratively across marketing, SDR, RevOps/MOPs, you will architect, execute, and optimize full-funnel demand generation programs that move the needle on revenue. The ideal candidate is an expert B2B growth marketer who operates with a high degree of autonomy and possesses strong experience scaling global ABM programs. You will own the strategic deployment of 1:few (industry and cohort-aligned), and 1:many (scaled, always-on) ABM programs spanning paid, owned, and earned channels. This role is responsible for the ongoing optimization and account research via the 6sense platform, and will partner closely with Global Regional leadership to drive high-value New Logo acquisition and support Expansion (Customer) cross-sell motions. Responsibilities: Define, develop, and lead the overarching ABM program for the global upper Commercial Enterprise segments, ensuring a consistent, personalized experience across channels to accelerate pipeline and growth. Architect and execute multi-tiered ABM strategies, including targeted 1:Few plays for top-tier accounts, 1:few industry-specific vertical campaigns, and programmatic 1:many campaigns for broader market capture. Serve as the global super-user and strategic marketing owner of the 6sense platform; govern data-driven segment building, mature intent keyword architecture, and automated orchestration playbooks. Partner closely with Sales and Regional Marketing Leads to establish deep feedback loops, aligning ABM programs with localized sales goals while maintaining a unified global strategy. Establish measurement frameworks and campaign metrics alongside marketing analytics teams Oversee the collaborative creation of bespoke content and high-impact messaging tailored to specific target account lists, industries, and/or executive personas across email, executive events, paid media, and conversational marketing. Conduct market, industry, and account-level research to uncover unmet needs, pain points, and buying triggers, translating these insights into actionable ABM playbooks. What You Bring to Our Camp Skills and Qualifications: Proven track record of designing, building, and scaling comprehensive 1:few, and 1:many ABM programs that measurably drive net-new ARR and customer expansion in the SaaS/B2B technology space. 6+ years of marketing experience, with a heavy emphasis on demand generation, enterprise campaigns, or vertical marketing. 3+ years of dedicated Account-Based Marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
